title: Combined machine configuration
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $m$ be the number of registers, and let $k_D$ be the number of simulated machine work tapes. Given a control state, an input-head position, register-tape contents and head positions, simulated work-tape contents and head positions, and an output list, define the combined configuration to have the given control state, input-head position, and output, with the register tapes and simulated work tapes concatenated in that order, and likewise their head positions.
hypotheses_covered: Control state is optional and belongs to the program simulator state type
Input-head position lies among the $|x|+2$ positions
Register tape contents and positions for $m$ registers
Simulated tape contents and positions for $k_D$ tapes
